spans.s: If a bee catches an insect, it becomes so much panic stricken that it begins to think about the danger from the bee, day and night. It thinks so much about it that the insect becomes the bee itself. This maxim refers to the deepest type of meditation.
This maxim refers to a person, striving hard to save his life, as an insect thrown out from the running water, takes resort on a tree somehow or other.
